name: FrenchModelVariant412_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant412_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 32-byte config at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets a root part and six parts and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame, calling the trail helper from the capture start, and returns the phase result; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md; notes/overlays/french-model-variant412-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-395 images build the French header-412 source with the palette column 512 instead of 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
